title: Document HCUP, MEPS and AHA access workflows
objective: Restricted, paid and public products have useful next steps without false access claims.
outcome: HCUP, MEPS and AHA have evidence-backed access workflows. Public MEPS files are not labeled restricted solely because another MEPS product is restricted. AHA terms are not inferred. Each workflow step cites a source; undocumented fees or eligibility remain unknown. USHSO never collects a user's eligibility or credentials. An agent can explain the next legitimate step and cannot claim a successful restricted-data download. Catalog, license and payload access remain separate dimensions. Sealed packages/identity/src and named-source-registry are not edited. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Separate products and access classes
commits.instructions: Capture current publisher documentation for HCUP products, public/restricted MEPS variants and AHA Annual Survey. Record what is included, eligibility, fees/unknown fees, training and agreements.
commits.verification: Public MEPS files are not labeled restricted solely because another MEPS product is restricted; AHA terms are not inferred.

commits.subject: Build evidence-backed workflow cards
commits.instructions: Describe required actions, official application/download links, expected artifacts and documented turnaround or unknown. Never collect a user's eligibility or credentials in USHSO.
commits.verification: Each step cites a source; an undocumented fee or eligibility criterion remains unknown rather than guessed.

commits.subject: Verify human and machine route output
commits.instructions: Test source-name discovery and route inspection for each product type; add guide links and explicit failure/blocked cases.
commits.verification: An agent can explain the next legitimate step and cannot claim a successful restricted-data download.
